jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a royal palace hall in thin white line art, a throne, tall pillars. Scene: a humble servant drawn all in WHITE (white clothes, white skin, white hair), NOT coloured, NOT black-filled stands alone in front of an empty throne, bowing slightly with his right hand on his chest and his left hand open, speaking wisely. Only one person. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.  Every object (boats, bowls, buckets, walls, furniture) is drawn WHITE-filled with thin dark outlines, never black-filled; the ground and sky are pure black with thin white lines, no brown, no green, no grey fills.
